source_name: ORF Volksgruppen (Slovenci) - Austrian-Slovenian minority service
why_relevant: Niche but genuinely useful bridge source for Austrian-parent appointments into Slovenia (it reported the new Sparkasse Slovenia head), covering the Austria-Slovenia axis that neither the Graz parent's German press room nor the Ljubljana media reliably carry.

source_name: Sister-subsidiary press rooms as relay channels (VUB, PBZ, Pravex, OTP Croatia)
why_relevant: Group-level appointments affecting Slovenia are frequently republished in full by sister subsidiaries in other countries (observed for the Intesa International Subsidiary Banks head at VUB and Pravex). When the SI site or the HQ page is unreachable, these mirrors preserve the original wording and date - a practical anti-blackout redundancy.

source_name: Subsidiary annual reports / letno porocilo (governance chapter)
why_relevant: Annual reports and Pillar 3 'razkritja' documents state the board composition as at 31 December plus every change during the year with exact dates and reasons (e.g. the Feb 2023 end of a board mandate at ISP Slovenia). This is the ground-truth backfill layer that repairs gaps left by missed press releases.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of SI subsidiaries (Banka Intesa Sanpaolo, OTP banka, Sparkasse, Nexi)
why_relevant: Often the fastest public signal of an appointment or reorganisation, and the primary channel for hiring/jobs signals in this cell. However it is legally and technically the most constrained source in the set.

source_name: AJPES JOLP - Javna objava letnih poročil (public disclosure of annual reports)
why_relevant: The statutory archive of filed annual reports for ALL Slovenian legal entities including banks, savings banks (hranilnice) and payment-sector companies (Bankart, fintechs, ISVs). Filed reports carry the audited employee-number disclosures (povprečno število zaposlenih po izobrazbenih skupinah), employee-cost notes, and the business report section describing organisational structure. This is the only place non-listed banks/hranilnice and payment vendors are systematically captured. Public disclosure of FY2025 reports occurred 2026-08-05.

source_name: AJPES eObjave - court register entries and insolvency/statutory publications
why_relevant: Official publication of court-register (sodni register) entries - including changes of representatives and statutory bodies, mergers and status changes. A merger such as Nova KBM into SKB/OTP, or a board change at a non-listed bank, leaves a dated legal trace here even when nothing appears on SEOnet.

source_name: NLB Group investor relations - annual reports and financial reports
why_relevant: NLB is Slovenia's largest bank and the only domestically listed one. Its annual report carries group headcount (8,107 employees at end-2025 per the FY2025 report coverage), branch counts, the corporate governance statement (izjava o upravljanju), management/supervisory board composition and tenure tables, and the remuneration report with named board pay. Parallel SL and EN editions make it the reference document for the whole cell.

source_name: NLB Pillar 3 / Razkritja po 3. stebru baselskih standardov
why_relevant: Pillar 3 disclosure carries the CRR-mandated remuneration tables: numbers of identified staff (zaposleni s posebno naravo dela), headcount in high-earner bands, split by business line, plus board recruitment/suitability policy. This is quantitative staffing structure that never appears in press coverage.

source_name: UniCredit Banka Slovenija - annual report and Pillar 3 disclosures
why_relevant: Non-listed foreign-owned bank that nonetheless publishes a full Slovenian annual report and a separate 'Razkritja ... za leto 2025' Pillar 3 document with CRR Art. 13 templates including remuneration and governance. Direct evidence of board composition and staffing for a major SI bank not covered by SEOnet.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (Slovenia) - governance pages and annual report
why_relevant: Post-merger entity (Nova KBM + SKB) and the second-largest SI bank, so it is the single richest source of organisation-change evidence in the market. Maintains dedicated 'Uprava banke' and 'Nadzorni svet' pages with current composition, an internal-governance section (statutory governance disclosure), a dedicated merger-information document set, and annual reports for the OTP Skupina Slovenija.

source_name: SID banka - annual report and Pillar 3 (3. steber) disclosures
why_relevant: State-owned promotional bank; publishes a full group annual report (FY2025 available) and a separate Basel Pillar 3 disclosure document. Governed additionally under state-holding rules, so board composition and remuneration are unusually well documented.

source_name: Gorenjska banka - Letna poročila in razkritja dodatnih informacij
why_relevant: A single landing page collecting both the annual reports and the additional (Pillar 3) disclosures for a mid-sized AIK-owned Slovenian bank - i.e. exactly the archival record this cell needs for a bank with little press coverage. The page title itself is the canonical Slovenian phrase to reuse when hunting the same page on other bank sites.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenija - annual reports (publications directory)
why_relevant: Another major non-listed foreign-owned SI bank publishing a full Slovenian annual report with governance and employee sections; the /document/publications/ISPSLOVENIA/<year>/ path pattern makes yearly retrieval predictable.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Nadzorniska razkritja in seznami (supervisory disclosures)
why_relevant: CRD-mandated supervisory disclosure including aggregate statistical data on the Slovenian banking sector - sector-level staff and branch counts that provide the denominator against which individual-bank headcount trends are read.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Publikacije / Letno porocilo (central bank annual report)
why_relevant: The central bank's own annual report is itself a statutory disclosure with its organisational structure, board (Svet Banke Slovenije) composition and its own headcount - relevant because BS is a significant employer of banking-supervision talent and a source of leadership moves into/out of commercial banks.

source_name: SDH - Slovenski drzavni holding, annual report on management of state capital investments
why_relevant: For state-owned/state-participated banks (NLB residual stake, SID banka, and historically NKBM), SDH's statutory annual report documents supervisory-board appointments and nominations, board remuneration rules under ZSDH-1, and per-company governance reviews. It is the archival record of who was appointed to which bank supervisory board by the state, and when.

source_name: Zdruzenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) - Bank Association annual report
why_relevant: The association's own annual report aggregates sector-level statistics and lists member banks and their representatives on ZBS committees - a compact cross-bank roster of senior functional leaders (payments, IT, compliance) that is otherwise scattered across bank sites. Useful for mapping who holds which functional role across the whole SI banking sector.

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. - annual reports (payments processing)
why_relevant: Slovenia's dominant card/payment processing centre and therefore the key payments-sector employer for this run's sector=both scope. Publishes its statutory annual report as PDF on its own site (historic editions confirmed) and files with AJPES; the report carries headcount and organisational description. Its /zaposlitev page doubles as a hiring signal.

source_name: Drustvo Mali delnicarji Slovenije (MDS) - SEOnet aggregation by bank
why_relevant: Minority-shareholder association that aggregates SEOnet notices and maintains per-bank taxonomy pages (NLB, Gorenjska banka, Addiko, SKB, BKS Bank, Sberbank, DBS, Intesa Sanpaolo, Delavska hranilnica, Primorska hranilnica, Hranilnica LON, SID banka, UniCredit). An effective index for finding which banks have historically issued disclosures and for snowballing to smaller institutions this cell must still cover.

source_name: OPSI - podatki.gov.si open data: Poslovni register Slovenije dataset
why_relevant: Bulk, licence-clean open-data distribution of the Slovenian business register. The lawful way to obtain the entity backbone (names, IDs, activity codes, status) at scale for the banking/payments universe without scraping ePRS, and to detect entity status changes over time.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — Dan slovenskih bančnikov / Bančna konferenca
why_relevant: The flagship annual Slovenian banking-sector conference. Its programme and speaker list is effectively a curated roster of current senior banking job titles (uprava, direktor plačilnih storitev, vodja digitalizacije) across NLB, NKBM/OTP, SKB, Intesa, Addiko, Delavska hranilnica and Bankart, plus Banka Slovenije officials. Year-on-year diffing of speaker rosters reveals leadership moves and new org units before formal press announcements.

source_name: ZBS — Terminski plan (event calendar)
why_relevant: Forward-looking calendar of ZBS conferences, working-group meetings and professional trainings. Acts as a pointer that tells the collector WHEN new speaker rosters and programme PDFs will appear, so scraping can be timed rather than blind-polled.

source_name: ZBS — Strokovna izobraževanja (professional training programme)
why_relevant: ZBS training catalogue lists in-house lecturers, who are almost always practising bank specialists named with their current role (e.g. compliance, AML, payments operations). A weak but rich signal for identifying who holds which function inside each bank, and which capability areas banks are actively staffing up.

source_name: Money Motion (Zagreb) — CEE fintech conference, speaker roster
why_relevant: The largest fintech conference in CEE (~120+ speakers, Zagreb, March). Slovenian payments and fintech executives appear regularly on its stages — Slovenian trade press explicitly covers 'slovenski fintech talenti' at Money Motion. Speaker bios give current employer + exact title for the Slovenian payments cohort, often ahead of local announcements.

source_name: Svet24 / Uporabna stran — Slovenian trade coverage of Money Motion speakers
why_relevant: Slovenian-language articles that name which Slovenian fintech/payments figures are speaking at regional conferences (e.g. Benjamin Jošar, Nina Dremelj, Antonio Argir). Useful as a pointer to individuals and their current affiliations, and as a way to catch Slovenian participation the English event site buries.

source_name: Dnevi slovenske informatike (DSI) — annual programme and speaker pages
why_relevant: The main Slovenian IT/informatics conference (33rd edition), with a persistent per-year site structure including an explicit '/stran/govorci' speakers page. Banking and payments IT leadership (CIO/CTO/head of digital channels at NLB, NKBM/OTP, Bankart, Halcom) present here. Multi-year archive makes it one of the best longitudinal title-tracking sources in the cell.

source_name: INFOSEK — Slovenian cyber-security conference (Nova Gorica), speakers and awards
why_relevant: Largest Slovenian information-security event (~800 attendees, 150+ speakers, 2-4 Sept 2026, Hotel Perla). Bank CISOs, fraud/AML and payment-security leads speak here with full titles; the event also hands out awards. Strong for detecting new security/fraud org units inside banks and processors, which usually precede hiring waves.
